scope: Royal Jordanian passenger checked-baggage acceptance for ORD departures
boundary: Public-source fact model only. It is not an airline, airport, handler, or TSA authorization.

departureTerminal.note: FlyChicago enplanement data places Royal Jordanian in Terminal 5. Exact counter and receiving point remain unverified.

counterClosure.note: RJ publishes this as the latest passenger acceptance time from Chicago, not a Travelyt handoff cutoff.

recommendedPassengerArrival.note: Travelyt's controlled simulation uses this as the target airline handoff time until RJ provides a stricter written station rule.

bagTagIssuance.value: RJ issues one Baggage Identification Tag when checked baggage is checked in
bagTagIssuance.note: Public terms do not authorize Travelyt to issue or activate airline bag tags.

screening.value: Checked baggage is subject to TSA screening and possible physical opening
screening.note: The exact ORD system routing and custody boundary are security-sensitive operational details and are not inferred here.

passengerBoardingLink.value: RJ normally will not carry checked baggage if the passenger fails to board
passengerBoardingLink.note: This does not answer whether an authorized third party may tender a bag before the passenger arrives.

ordGroundHandler.note: No authoritative public source reviewed identifies RJ's current ORD passenger/ramp handling provider.

passengerAbsentTenderAuthority.note: RJ must state in writing whether Travelyt may tender a sealed passenger bag without the passenger physically present.

receivingRoleAndLocation.note: Named role, counter/door, hours, escalation owner, and refusal/return process are missing.

dcsBsmApiContract.note: RJ must supply approved message mapping, credentials, idempotency, timeout reconciliation, webhook rules, and tag activation semantics.
